STEP 3.Using scan tool MB991502, check data list.
CAUTION
To prevent damage to scan tool MB991502, always turn the 
ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position before 
connecting or disconnecting scan tool MB991502.
(1) Using scan tool MB991502.
(2) Connect scan tool MB991502 to the data link connector.
(3) Check the following items in the data list.
Refer to P.17-74, Data List Reference Table.
• Item 04: Auto-cruise control "CANCEL" switch.
• Item 05: Stoplight switch.
• Item 14: Clutch pedal position switch <M/T>.
• Item 14: Park/neutral position switch <A/T>.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
Q: Is the check above meet the specifications?
YES : Check that the malfunction is eliminated. 
If the malfunction is eliminated, replace the auto-
cruise control-ECU. (Refer to P.17-81.)
Then that the malfunction is eliminated.
NO : Follow the diagnostic trouble code procedures and 
the symptom procedures below.
• Item 04: Refer to Diagnostic Trouble Code 
Procedures number 15 P.17-28. 
• Item 05: Refer to Symptom Procedures number 2 
P.17-46. 
• Item 14: Refer to Symptom Procedures number 3 
<M/T> P.17-53.
• Item 14: Refer to Symptom Procedures number 4 
<A/T> P.17-58.
